module_summary: Four-stage pipelined 64-bit ripple adder: 16-bit slices added per stage with registered carries, operand skew and sum de-skew registers, and an i_en-to-o_en valid chain.

anchors.name: adda
anchors.why: 64-bit operand A, split into four 16-bit slices.

anchors.name: addb
anchors.why: 64-bit operand B, split into four 16-bit slices.

anchors.name: i_en
anchors.why: Input valid enabling stage-1 add and entering the valid chain.

anchors.name: result
anchors.why: 65-bit sum concatenated from final carry and aligned stage sums.

anchors.name: o_en
anchors.why: Output valid, i_en delayed through stage1-3 chain.

anchors.name: stage1
anchors.why: Valid-chain bit enabling stage-2 add; stage2/stage3 enable later stages.

anchors.name: s1
anchors.why: Stage-1 16-bit slice sum; s2-s4 are later-stage twins.

anchors.name: c1
anchors.why: Registered carry passed to next stage; c4 is final carry-out.

anchors.name: a2_ff1
anchors.why: Operand skew register delaying upper slices to their stage.

anchors.name: s1_ff1
anchors.why: Sum de-skew register aligning early slice sums to result.

groups.name: valid_chain
groups.description: Shift chain of enables tracking data through four stages.

groups.name: slice_adders
groups.description: Four 16-bit adder stages with registered carry ripple.

groups.name: operand_skew
groups.description: Delay lines feeding upper operand slices to their stage.

groups.name: sum_deskew
groups.description: Delay lines aligning slice sums into result.
